title: Where can I find alpha testers?
author: JefersonTomazella
selftext:
I'm asking here because other gaming communities just downvote AI games.

I'm creating a casual fishing game and I wanted some playtesting before I move to the finished version, to check if I need to change anything.

Do you guys know a place I can find alpha testers (for free, I can't afford paying yet) that don't mind if a game is done using AI or not? (only care for the game being good).  
  
I want this game to be good and fun, and with only 2 testers for now (me and my brother who's the fishing expert)

comments.author: JefersonTomazella
comments.body:
A lot of friends said they are going to play it when they have time, but still didn't had the time. 

Two friends gave me a better feedback than "nice bro".

comments.author: StarMonkeyGames
comments.body:
Friends and other devs. Basically, we play and engage with our own content to help the snowball build. No one wants to watch prototype AI game commercials. Can you blame them? 

[https://www.youtube.com/@StarMonkeyGames/videos](https://www.youtube.com/@StarMonkeyGames/videos)

[https://discord.gg/tsT5qjH7s](https://discord.gg/tsT5qjH7s)

feel free to hop on and drop some links

replies.author: JefersonTomazella
replies.body: Thanks, I will. My game actually doesn't seem like AI, because I'm not using full AI. I'm just using it to help me code and sometimes do small tweaks on some sprites.

replies.author: StarMonkeyGames
replies.body:
It's witch hunting season right now. Just make the best game you can make. Eventually you'll be ahead of the game.

I know from experience that Google and other major companies are all in on AI and the software you use is all AI now.
